response.sql:
SELECT f.orderslink, o.mktnote, AVG(f.rebrate) AS avg_maker_rebate_rate, SUM(f.rebtotal) AS total_rebate
FROM fees AS f
JOIN orders AS o
  ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
WHERE f.feerate > 0.0009
GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.mktnote
ORDER BY total_rebate DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: “Ignoring missing values” means the standard AVG and SUM behavior: NULL rebate rates and totals are excluded from their respective aggregates.
